$comment: Personalization on top of AllQuestions/all-questions-definition.json. Edit this file, then run the regenerate test in AllQuestionsPersonalizedTests to rewrite all-questions-personalized-definition.json, all-questions-personalized-variable-presets.json and the expected files. variablePresets declares the audience variables the overlay reads as Survey Creator variable presets ({definition, presets, totalPresets}), typed as the Audience variables read types them (Endatix.Modules.Audience VariableDefinition and PresetBuilder) and in the audience's Property order: definition has one question per variable, and presets holds placeholder Test participants. It stays out of the composed definition; load all-questions-personalized-variable-presets.json as the designer's variablePresets. Every {name} the bindings and addElements read must be a question or a declared variable, no question or calculated value may share a variable's name, and every preset value must fit its variable; AllQuestionsPersonalizedTests checks all three. bindings set or replace properties of an existing question, found by name anywhere in the survey; addElements are appended to the first page.
